items.name: shield
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent production game sprite animation sheet.
Create exactly 8 full-body sprites in a precisely aligned 4 column x 2 row grid. Requested canvas 1536 x 1024 pixels, eight equal 384 x 512 cells. Genuine transparent RGBA background; no painted checkerboard.
Use the supplied reference as the exact character identity, outfit, proportions, render style, rear three-quarter camera and up-right facing direction. Fixed camera and fixed character scale in ALL frames. Every sprite complete, centered at exactly the same position within its cell, 10% clear padding around every part.
CRITICAL STATIONARY ANIMATION: the pelvis, thighs, knees, calves and boots MUST BE EXACTLY IDENTICAL to the first frame in EVERY cell: same lower-body pixels, same coordinates, same planted stance. Both soles stay firmly planted on the same spots. No stepping, no walking, no foot lifting, no leg rotation, no knee motion, no lunge, no body translation. Animate ONLY shoulders, head, arms, hands and equipment above the waist. Reuse identical lower body across all eight frames.
Row 1 is four attack poses left to right: neutral anticipation, attack impact, upper-body follow-through, return to neutral.
Row 2 is four skill poses left to right: skill anticipation, activation, hold, return to neutral.
No extra effects, flashes, muzzle flashes, magic, beams, rings, shadows, ground planes, text, labels, UI, grid lines, detached or floating equipment. Equipment must stay naturally held and attached to hands. All sprite parts stay entirely within their own cell.
Character: the reference bald muscular olive-armored shield soldier with blue tall riot shield, white shield insignia, backpack, belt pouches and baton. Attack is a short, braced shield bash: arms draw shield back, push shield a little upward-right at impact, settle, return. The torso can twist slightly but pelvis and boots do not move. Skill is a defensive shield guard: raise and brace shield in front of upper torso, hold, return. The shield stays fully in the cell and physically held in each frame; baton remains attached to hand. Keep both boots and all legs exactly stationary.

items.name: sniper-directional
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent production game sprite animation sheet.
Primary request: Create a DIRECTIONAL crouched shooting animation sheet for the exact sniper character in the reference. Same red beret, brown ponytail, dark blue coat with light fur collar, brown tactical backpack, red canisters, armored boots, long scoped rifle with dark suppressor. Match stylized hand-painted game sprite rendering.
Canvas: requested 1536 x 1920 pixels, EXACTLY 4 columns x 5 rows, 20 equal square cells of 384 x 384. Genuine transparent RGBA background. No checkerboard, no text, no labels, no grids.
Fixed overhead three-quarter game camera, looking downward 50 degrees toward character, identical camera and scale in every cell; keep world upright. This is a character turning IN the world, NOT a sprite rotated as a flat image.
Every sprite is a complete crouched/kneeling full body, one knee near ground, aiming scoped rifle. Within each row the lower body is completely planted and identical, pelvis, knees and boots precisely fixed; only arms/head/shoulders/rifle recoil subtly. Four poses in each row: aimed ready, subtle backward recoil along barrel axis, recovery, aimed ready.
DIRECTION REQUIREMENTS are screen-space vectors of the rifle barrel from breech toward muzzle:
ROW 1: NORTH, rifle points STRAIGHT UP on screen, exact -90 degree vertical direction. View the character mainly from behind. Long barrel and visible muzzle above head.
ROW 2: NORTHEAST, rifle points diagonally UP-RIGHT on screen, exact -45 degrees. Rear three-quarter view.
ROW 3: EAST, rifle points STRAIGHT RIGHT on screen, exact 0 degrees horizontal. Side view.
ROW 4: SOUTHEAST, rifle points diagonally DOWN-RIGHT on screen, exact +45 degrees. Front three-quarter view.
ROW 5: SOUTH, rifle points STRAIGHT DOWN on screen, exact +90 degrees vertical. Front view. Rifle barrel visible extending toward bottom of cell, muzzle at bottom, rifle stock closer to shoulder above.
Do not repeat northeast poses in all rows. The five rifle axes must visibly differ and match N, NE, E, SE, S respectively. Keep muzzle clearly visible in all 20 sprites, and exact direction constant within each row. Rifle remains physically shouldered and held by both hands.
Each character centered consistently in own cell, no part crosses cell boundary, 8% clear padding, same silhouette height/scale across poses, no overlap.
NO baked muzzle flash, smoke, bullets, projectile trails, fire, floor shadows, particles, UI or extra objects. Reference shows a crouch transition; use its fully crouched pose identity, but generate the requested five facing directions.
